Venture capitalist Tim Draper said investors searching for the next major artificial intelligence opportunity should look beyond leading model developers such as OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI and focus on companies building applications around the technology.



The AI Leaders Have Already Emerged



Draper said the battle among foundation model companies is largely being fought by OpenAI, xAI and Ant
